描述_EN: the bronze mixture used is a most unusual alloy of copper, iron, tin and lead. this bronze buddha head is over one metre high and is all that remains of an enormous statue. the head was cast in sections, and such was the skill of the sculptors, despite the size and a weight of around 100 kilos, it is hollow and the metal itself is only three millimetres thick. the sections are so thin and fine that details like the lips and eyes can be traced in hollow relief inside. such an image would have been very expensive to produce and must surely have come from an important temple.
描述_ZN: 使用的青铜混合物是一种最不寻常的铜、铁、锡和铅的合金。 这个青铜佛首超过一米高，是一个巨大的雕像的全部遗迹。 这个头像是分段铸造的，雕塑家的技术如此高超，尽管它的尺寸和重量约为100公斤，但它是空心的，金属本身只有三毫米的厚度。 这些部分是如此之薄和精细，以至于像嘴唇和眼睛这样的细节都可以在里面的空心浮雕中描摹出来。 这样一尊佛像的制作成本很高，肯定是来自一个重要的寺庙。
